paragraph: The Granville composite delivers a moderately constructive yet strictly capped verdict of 60/100, checked by an active negative breadth divergence as the equal-weight RSP/SPY ratio slips -0.18% despite broader market gains. Internal leadership shows stark bifurcation: strong speculative thrust in bellwether semiconductors (SOXX/SPY up +1.23%) and risk-on equities (SPHB/SPLV gaining +1.27%) is counterbalanced by classical Dow Theory vulnerability, highlighted by a sharp drag in transports (IYT/SPY falling -1.51%). The macro backdrop offers a benign holding pattern for equities, marked by a falling VIX (down -2.21% to a calm 16.82), stable high-yield credit spreads at 2.76%, and stationary 10-year real yields at 2.60%. Meanwhile, near-flat reads across defensive rotation (XLP/XLY at -0.08%), credit confidence (HYG/LQD at -0.19%), and currency pairs (USD/JPY at ¥155.05) signal an absence of broad distribution. Maintain a cautiously bullish lean focused on mega-cap tech leadership for the session, but keep profit targets tight as poor transport participation and narrowing breadth limit upside follow-through.
